name: a6fdvd-u14-hub-about-primary
goal: U14 Hub about page: the hero has one filled primary (Log in); the pending 'Mac app coming soon' becomes a muted chip (not a filled link to #download); no enabled button without an action (specification/designs/full-pass/README.md section U14)

evidence: Failing behaviour: on /about (HomeHero, pending Mac build) the hero shows 'Mac app coming soon' as a filled primary link to #download, so two controls look enabled and the hero has two filled-looking actions. Expected (design record specification/designs/full-pass/README.md U14): Log in is the one filled primary in the hero; the pending Mac name is a muted chip (span.home-badge), not a link or button; once published, Download for Mac is the one filled primary.

Existing standardized tests covered the hero's link targets and labels (packages/hub/test/components/public-site/home-download.test.ts, 'the hero download goes to the build...') and the hosted-home e2e pending test (packages/hub/tests/e2e/hosted-home.spec.ts 'a missing|page Mac archive keeps the download pending'), but they asserted the pending hero as a link to #download, so no test counted filled primaries in the hero or checked that the pending name is not an action. Gap: the assertion for one filled primary per hero and the no-dead-action rule. Repair: strengthen those two existing tests in place (no new file).
Replayed the committed Hub home-download test at d56f2c246d. Two hero assertions fail: the pending Mac action is a link and Log in lacks the primary styling.
The existing U14 fix c8dc99ab84 makes Log in the primary action and renders the pending Mac application as a chip.
Replayed the same committed Hub home-download test at c8dc99ab84. All six tests passed.
